text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
~♪ ~♪
Oh, look who it is! Hey there, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Got a problem with me being energetic, punk?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Eat three square meals, move around a bit, and sleep...
Anyone'd feel refreshed after that!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Come on! I'm gonna break away with everything I've got...
So don't you dare slack on coaching me, either!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City spent a healthy day off
and seemed to have restored her energy.
